scene.ar: توفي والد زميلك في العمل. تذهب مع الزملاء إلى بيت العائلة، وتجد زميلك عند الباب يستقبل المعزّين.
scene.en: A colleague's father has passed away. You go with others from work to the family home, and find your colleague at the door receiving people.

say.en: Indeed we belong to Allāh, and indeed to Him we will return

say.ar: إنَّ لِلَّه ما أَخَذ ولَهُ ما أَعطَى، وكلُّ شَيءٍ عِنده بِأجَل مُسمَّى فَلتَصبِر ولتَحتَسِب
say.en: To Allah belongs what He takes, and to Him belongs what He gives, and for everything He sets a specific term. So she should have patience and seek the reward from Allah

why.en: offering condolences in times of affliction

text.en: (Ali shakes your hand, his voice tired.) Thank you for coming.

quote.ar: إنَّ لِلَّه ما أَخَذ ولَهُ ما أَعطَى، وكلُّ شَيءٍ عِنده بِأجَل مُسمَّى فَلتَصبِر ولتَحتَسِب
quote.en: To Allah belongs what He takes, and to Him belongs what He gives, and for everything He sets a specific term. So she should have patience and seek the reward from Allah

text.ar: أنا آسف جدًا لمصابك. أقول لك ما قاله النبي ﷺ:
text.en: I am so sorry for your loss. Let me say to you what the Prophet ﷺ said:

quote.ar: إنَّ لِلَّه ما أَخَذ ولَهُ ما أَعطَى، وكلُّ شَيءٍ عِنده بِأجَل مُسمَّى
quote.en: To Allah belongs what He takes, and to Him belongs what He gives, and for everything He sets a specific term

text.ar: أنا آسف جدًا لفقدك. إن احتجت شيئًا فأنا هنا.
text.en: I'm so sorry for your loss. If you need anything, I'm here.

text.ar: لا تحزن، كان كبيرًا في السن على أي حال.
text.en: Don't be sad; he was old anyway.

text.ar: كان الأمر مفاجئًا. لا أعرف ماذا أقول.
text.en: It was so sudden. I don't know what to say.

quote.en: Indeed we belong to Allāh, and indeed to Him we will return

text.ar: لا بأس ألّا تجد كلامًا. جاء في القرآن:
text.en: It's all right to have no words. The Quran says:

quote.en: Indeed we belong to Allāh, and indeed to Him we will return

text.en: That's all right. I'm with you.
You need to get over this quickly.

prompt.en: What does someone struck by a loss say?

quote.en: Indeed we belong to Allāh, and indeed to Him we will return

prompt.en: With what words did the Prophet ﷺ console his daughter?

quote.en: To Allah belongs what He takes, and to Him belongs what He gives

text.en: That she should forget what happened
